jobs.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
jobs.summary: Help Aloden release dependable AI-enabled products by testing complete user journeys, APIs, permissions, and real-world failure cases.
jobs.responsibilities:
Build and maintain automated coverage for critical product journeys and service integrations.
Plan functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing alongside the engineering team.
Test authentication, permissions, data integrity, and multi-user workflows.
Create reliable test data and make failures reproducible and useful to developers.
Integrate automated checks into delivery pipelines and make release risks visible.
Help validate AI-enabled experiences, including uncertain outputs, fallback behavior, and human review.
jobs.requirements:
Practical experience designing and maintaining automated web and API tests.
Ability to investigate failures and communicate clear, reproducible defects.
Understanding of test strategy, regression coverage, and software delivery.
Comfort reading application code, inspecting network requests, and validating data.
A careful approach to security-sensitive workflows and realistic test data.
jobs.preferred:
Experience testing AI-assisted workflows or complex enterprise products.
Experience with performance, accessibility, or cross-browser testing.
Examples of test frameworks or release-quality improvements you have owned.
jobs.sourceNote: Title and hiring status confirmed by PK. QA description newly drafted; original DOCX contents not available. No experience minimum, work model, contract type or compensation inferred.
